title: 043 - Merge Sorted Lists
prompt: Fix the bug so the program merge the two sorted lists and print 1,2,3,4,7,8 and prints exactly `1,2,3,4,7,8`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
hint: Take the smaller front value first during the merge.
explanation: The broken merge chooses the wrong side during comparison. Picking the smaller current value fixes the merged order.
